text:
leo: FYI running into a weird one in the sample app during onboarding. When jsonMode + function-calls + retries are enabled, the node sdk sometimes double-encodes the tool arguments on retry and the schema validator chokes.

nina: Ugh. Do you have a tiny repro? Which retry/backoff layer? Is this the client retry or the server-side resend?

leo: Minimal repro: start sample-app with NODE_SDK=latest, JSON_MODE=1. Trigger a transient 502 from the tool handler to exercise the retry path. On first try the function call arguments are an array as expected. On retry we see `arguments: "[{\"text\":\"Acme\"}]"` (a stringified array) instead of a real array. Validator: `expected array but got string`.

omar: That sounds like the request body is being JSON-stringified twice before send on retry. We had a change that does shallowClone + stringify to preserve headers in the retry wrapper. Looks like for function-call payloads we accidentally stringify the args field again.

jen: Can you paste the short console trace? Also are you on Node SDK 0.12.x or 0.13.x? We had a tweak in 0.13 that touched the retry wrapper.

leo: Trace snippet:
```
[send] payload.arguments = [ { text: 'Acme' } ]
-- transient 502 --
[retry] payload.arguments = JSON.stringify(payload.arguments)
http post -> body: { model: 'x', input: '...', function_call: { name: 'extract_entities', arguments: "[{\"text\":\"Acme\"}]" } }
schema-validator ERROR: expected array but got string at function_call.arguments
```

nina: Yikes. Quick workaround for sample-app: detect stringified arrays on handler side and JSON.parse if possible. But we should fix at source: retry wrapper must not mutate already-structured arguments.

omar: Agreed. I'll open a PR to change the retry wrapper to deep-clone the whole body and not re-stringify JS objects that are already serialized. Also add a unit test that simulates a 502 and asserts the function_call.arguments type is preserved.

jen: Also add an integration test in sample-kit: run app with a flaky tool that returns 502 once and confirm handler receives proper array. That will prevent regressions in future SDK changes.

leo: Created a local quickfix in sample-app:
```js
// shim in handler
if (typeof args === 'string') {
  try { args = JSON.parse(args) } catch(e) { /* leave as-is, validator will fail */ }
}
```
Works for onboarding but we need the SDK patch ASAP.

lint-bot: New issue created: DEVEX-902 "node-sdk retry wrapper double-encodes function-call args" (assigned to @omar). Suggested labels: bug, sdk-parity, test-needed.

jen: Can someone grab a small changelog blurb for the SDK release notes? This can block new signups running quickstarts with jsonMode.

omar: Will send PR in next 2 hours with unit+e2e and a changelog entry.

leo: Thanks. Marking this as high-priority for onboarding flows. If anyone on call wants to pair on the test I'll be around.
